description: Worked example (docs/spec-format.md). Request: 'MX Master 4 profile for Rider: thumb button = Ctrl+Shift+A, back = Alt+Left, forward = Alt+Right, gesture left/right = previous/next tab'. On the MX Master 4 the thumb button IS the gesture button, so 'thumb = Ctrl+Shift+A' and thumb gestures cannot both hold: gestures keep the thumb button and Ctrl+Shift+A (Find Action) moves to the haptic sense panel. Assumption: previous/next tab = Ctrl+PageUp / Ctrl+PageDown - Rider's active keymap could not be read from its config; adjust if yours differs.
